LanguageData.Strata_Settings_UnlimitedLevelsDesc: When off (default), colony stacks stop at {0} floors below/above the stack root, and gravship stacks stop at 1 floor below/above the ship deck. Extra shafts can still join an already-open floor. Existing deeper/taller stacks keep working. When on, both colony and gravship caps are lifted (deeper gravship stacks are heavier on takeoff/landing).
LanguageData.Strata_LevelCap_MaxBelow: Level cap: cannot dig below B{0}. Enable Unlimited levels in Strata settings, or dig from a shallower floor.
LanguageData.Strata_LevelCap_MaxAbove: Level cap: cannot build above A{0}. Enable Unlimited levels in Strata settings, or build from a lower floor.
LanguageData.Strata_LevelCap_GravshipMax: Gravship level cap: ship stacks are limited to {0} level above and {0} level below the ship deck. Enable Unlimited levels in Strata settings, or land and dig from a colony floor.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_WorkRelayDesc: Idle colonists and colony mechanoids walk to other levels that have work when their own floor is idle. On by default. Does NOT control hauling through stairs — use Haul across levels for that. Turn this off in Mod Options if pawns should stay on their current floor.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_OffThreadWorkRelayDesc: A background scanner fills a per-floor work board that work relay reads (instead of probing during every idle think). Grow-zone flags can finish on a worker thread. On by default when Work relay is on; off in Performance mode.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_HaulAcrossLevelsDesc: Colonists and bots take Hauling jobs that carry items through stairwells to better storage / construction demand on linked floors. Separate from Work relay.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_RobotSoftCompatDesc: Cross-level portal routing for Misc. Robots (return-to-base when recharge is on another level). Turn off to A/B test whether Strata robot hooks cause lag.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_RobotWorkRelayDesc: When a bot finds no local haul/clean work, send it through stairwells toward linked levels that have work. Also lets bots leave an allowed-area restriction (e.g. underground station) to work upstairs. Off by default.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_ShaftFluidDesc: Cross-level fluid ties (water, helixien, coolant, etc.). Auto-disabled if repeated errors trip the fault guard.
LanguageData.Strata_FaultGuardTripped: Strata auto-disabled {0} after repeated errors. Re-enable in mod options if needed.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_FoodRelayDesc: Hungry colonists go find a meal on another level.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_RestRelayDesc: Sleepy colonists on a floor without beds walk to their assigned bed or a free bed on another linked level (Barracks role preferred).
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_MedicalRelayDesc: Patients and doctors commute to linked levels with medical beds or tending work.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_JoyRelayDesc: Recreation-starved colonists walk to another level with food joy or recreation buildings.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_CaravanPullDesc: While forming a caravan on the surface, colonists haul high-value goods up from linked underground levels.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_CrossLevelRitualsDesc: The ritual menu lists colonists from every linked level; those elsewhere walk to the ritual and join when they arrive.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_CrossLevelCaravansDesc: The form-caravan dialog lists colonists, prisoners, and colony animals from every linked level; those elsewhere walk to the surface gathering and join when they arrive. Downed pawns on other levels cannot climb and are left out.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_CageSustainHungerDesc: When off (default), canary and bird cages feed occupants from stocked hay or kibble. When on, hunger is frozen while a bird is caged — no food storage needed.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_ForeignPortals: Relay into other mods' portal maps
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_ForeignPortalsDesc: When off (default), Strata's cross-level systems (work, food, rest, medical, alerts) only treat Strata stairwells and elevators as level links. When on, portal maps from other mods — Anomaly undercaves, Deep And Deeper caves, and similar — also count as linked floors. Careful: colonists may then be sent into unstable or hostile maps on their own.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_GasSystemWarning: Opt-in: gas simulation is OFF by default. Enable only if you want atmospheric/smoke simulation — it can cost TPS on large or multi-level colonies.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_PollutantGasesDesc: Smoke, methane, deep gas pockets, spores, steam, black damp, and other harmful extras. Turning this off clears them, skips emit/drain/harm, and hides them on the gas overlay. Smoke inhalation severity below applies when this is on.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_AutoTagExhaustDesc: Add smoke comps to a named vanilla/DLC list (fueled stove and smithy, Ideology braziers and darktorches). Generators, campfires, and Homesteader burners are patched in XML either way. Off never scans other mods' buildings.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_VerboseLoggingDesc: Writes extra Strata diagnostics to Player.log (compat, map gen, gravship land/takeoff, exhaust auto-tag). Off by default.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_SmokeSimulationDesc: Burners give off smoke that pools in unventilated rooms. Turning this off clears all existing smoke.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_SmokeSeverity: Smoke inhalation severity: {0} (how fast pawns are harmed by thick smoke)
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_UndergroundGasDesc: Gas hazards of the deep: excavation can breach pockets of foul deep gas, and sunken ruin sites can appear. Sealed stairwells always contain gas either way.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_NaturalGasesDesc: Opt-in atmospheric breathing (N₂, O₂, Ar, CO₂). Surface and A+ rooms stay safe (ambient lock). B1+ sealed rooms: pawns consume O₂ / exhale CO₂; plants reverse; hypoxia without vents, pumps, or shafts. Off = fully breathable with no O₂ simulation.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_GravshipLifeSupportDesc: When on (default), gravship-linked underdecks and ship towers do not free-replenish oxygen. Use oxygen tanks/reclaimers, ordinary O₂ pumps, or an open stair umbilical to the host. Launches dump heat into gravship heatsinks (or ship rooms). Skips Strata launch heat when Vanilla Gravship Expanded already manages heat. Requires Natural gases for the O₂ half.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_BreathingSimulationDesc: Underground levels track oxygen and carbon dioxide: colonists breathe O₂, exhale CO₂, O₂ rises through shafts, and CO₂ sinks. Turning this off clears both gases.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_GasOverlayLabelsDesc: While the play-settings gas overlay is on, draw color-coded percentage labels on each enclosed room (top three gases + load). The cursor panel is always available when the overlay is on.
LanguageData.Strata_PlaySettings_GasOverlayTip: Strata: show gas overlay\nTints each room by its dominant hazardous gas. Move the mouse over a room for a cursor-attached gas mix panel. Optional per-room labels: Strata mod settings → Gas overlay room labels.
LanguageData.Strata_PlaySettings_CombinedResourcesTip: Strata: combined level resources (off by default)\nWhen on, resource readout, build costs, and “until you have X” bills count items in stockpiles/shelves on every linked floor. No cost while only one map is linked.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_RaidPursuitDesc: Raiders with nobody left to fight follow your colonists through unsealed stairwells.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_B1InfestationsDesc: When off, infestations (including deep-drill style) cannot fire on any underground Strata floor (B1 and deeper). Surface and A+ are unchanged.
LanguageData.Strata_Place_QuestMapNoShaft: Don't dig Strata shafts on temporary quest maps (Ancient Urban Ruins, world sites, etc.) — abandoning the site orphans the pocket levels. Use Strata on your home colony; use the other mod's floors for exploration.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_HibernateEmptyDesc: Vacant A+ and B+ pocket maps run vanilla ambient sims 1 tick in 4 and Strata gas 1 cycle in 8. Fully live on the map you are viewing or any level with pawns on it.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_ReduceBackgroundDesc: When colonists are on a linked level you are not viewing, Strata gas and O₂/CO₂ run 8× slower and skip overlay rebuilds. The map you are looking at stays full speed.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_PerformanceModeDesc: Disables colonist work relay, Misc. Robots soft-compat, and external JobGiver work relay. Also runs atmosphere sims 4× slower, uses lite batched O₂/CO₂ on all levels, throttles pawn gas harm checks, and skips gas motes on levels you are not viewing. Use to A/B test Strata lag.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_PerformanceModeActive: Performance mode is ON — cross-level work relays and robot soft-compat are suppressed.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_OffThreadAtmosphereDesc: Runs the per-cell cavern diffusion pass on a background thread (snapshot on main thread, apply on main thread). Reduces hitching on large underground maps. On by default; requires Natural gases. Turn off if you suspect atmosphere oddities.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_AtmosphereQualityDesc: Controls how often gas and O₂/CO₂ sim runs on background levels. Low is cheapest; High keeps the viewed level snappy.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_AtmosphereQualityLowDesc: Background levels run atmosphere 8× slower with batched room/plant passes. Animals skip gas harm unless already affected.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_AtmosphereQualityMediumD: Viewed level full speed; background occupied levels 4× slower with phased work spread across ticks.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_AtmosphereQualityHighDes: All levels run atmosphere at full rate; use if you notice delayed O₂ equalization on distant floors.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_LogRobotDiagnosticsDesc: Writes session counter totals and 60-second rates to the log. Off by default.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_ShowLevelPerf: Show level performance in Levels tab
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_ShowLevelPerfDesc: List pawn counts and hibernation status for each level in the Levels tab.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_ExplorationSitesDesc: World incidents that reveal sunken ruins, collapsed mines, sealed vaults, and geothermal vents.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_FloodEventsDesc: Groundwater seeps that flood patches of excavated levels.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_NativeCavernDesc: When Biomes! Caverns is not loaded, excavated levels (B1+) use Strata cave networks. If Biomes! is loaded, Biomes! always wins layout generation — this only applies as a fallback if Biomes! fails.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_AncientStairwellDesc: Some new colony maps spawn a pre-built ancient stairwell on the surface. It opens the first underground level without digging-down research, but does not carry power between levels.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_BiomesCavernsDesc: Biomes! Caverns always owns dig layout when loaded (plants/fauna/stalagmites when this is on). If Biomes! leaves a hollow contour with almost no rock — common when digging under mountains — Strata falls back to its own rock fill so the floor stays mineable. Also checks the mountain footprint upstairs so edge rock alone cannot hide an empty dig.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_MultiFloorStairsDesc: Use bundled alternate art from Textures/Strata/Buildings/MultiFloors/ (handrail stairs + modern elevator). Does not require the MultiFloors mod.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_MultiFloorCredit: These Assets are from Multifloors, Telardo can ask for it to be removed.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_DepthDimDesc: When viewing an A+/roof deck, darken the whole screen slightly as a depth mood cue. Separate from see-below, which actually draws the floor under open-sky gaps.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_SeeBelow: See floor below through open sky
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_SeeBelowDesc: On A+ decks, draw the real map underneath through Strata open-sky holes (terrain, weather water, buildings, fog).
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_SeeBelowLiveDesc: Also draw moving things from the map below when looking through open sky.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_CrossLevelCombatDesc: Pawns, turrets, and mortars can shoot through Strata open-sky holes at the paired floor above or below (range includes the vertical gap).
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_CrossLevelAutoEngageDesc: Idle/hostiles and undrafted colonists with guns (and turrets with no local target) automatically fire through open sky. Drafted Fire-at-will also returns fire across the gap.
LanguageData.Strata_NoArcPath: No open-sky arc path to that cell.
LanguageData.Strata_NoGapLine: No open-sky line of fire to that target.
LanguageData.Strata_StopCrossBombardDesc: Cancel the current cross-level turret or mortar order.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_LinkedColonistsTabsDesc: Work and Schedule tabs show a Strata Levels checkbox (when your colony has excavated levels). When checked, both tabs list colonists from every linked level, not only the map you are viewing.
LanguageData.Strata_Settings_MergedAbandonWarningDesc: When abandoning a settlement with pawns still on levels below, show one combined warning listing everyone left behind (surface and underground). Turn off for two separate prompts.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_SmokeVacant_Explanation: Harmful gas is accumulating on a level with no colonists on it. Something is burning or seeping down there with no working ventilation - the next person to walk in will be breathing it.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_FlammableGas_Explanation: Flammable gas is pooling in a room that contains an open flame - a torch, a campfire, or a running fuel burner. When the gas thickens past ignition density the room will explode. Extinguish the flame, vent the room, or switch to electric light.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_CaravanGoods_Explanation: Valuable items remain on linked underground levels while a caravan is being formed on the surface. Enable caravan pull in Strata settings or haul them up manually before leaving.
LanguageData.Strata_MessageCaravanDownedExcluded: Cannot bring downed pawns from other levels into the caravan (they cannot climb): {0}
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_SealedColonists_Explanation: Colonists are on a linked level whose every exit shaft is sealed. They cannot return until a stairwell or elevator is unsealed.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_Canary_Explanation: A mine canary is distressed or dead from bad air in a cage. Canaries succumb sooner than colonists — ventilate the room or evacuate before people start coughing, suffocating, or worse.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_SleepBedNotFound_Explanatio: A colonist needs to sleep, but Strata found no free bed on their floor or any linked level (ground, above, or below). Build or free a colonist bed, or assign one manually.
LanguageData.Strata_StairsConnectedBelow: Broke through to the existing level below.
LanguageData.Strata_NoLandingCell: No clear landing cell on the existing floor (25-cell ring is blocked). Clear space around the shaft alignment, then try again — do not open a second parallel floor.
LanguageData.Strata_StairsConnectedAbove: Connected to the existing level above.
LanguageData.Strata_GravshipConnectedBelow: Broke through to the existing gravship deck below.
LanguageData.Strata_GravshipConnectedAbove: Connected to the existing gravship deck above.
LanguageData.Strata_LandingRepositioned: Stairwell landing repositioned beneath the shaft above.
LanguageData.Strata_SomeoneBelow: Someone is still on the level below.
LanguageData.Strata_SomeoneAbove: Someone is still on the level above.
LanguageData.Strata_AbandonLevelBelowConfirm:
Removing this stairwell or elevator will collapse the linked level below if nothing else connects to it.

Anything still on that floor (buildings, items, plants) will be lost. Colonists still below block removal.

Abandon the linked level?
LanguageData.Strata_AbandonLevelAboveConfirm:
Removing this stairwell or elevator will collapse the linked level above if nothing else connects to it.

Anything still on that floor (buildings, items, plants) will be lost. Colonists still above block removal.

Abandon the linked level?
LanguageData.Strata_SmokeShaftOpen: Smoke shaft: fumes rise to the level above
LanguageData.Strata_PowerShaft: Power shaft: ties both levels' grids (wire each floor into the stairwell; batteries optional for overnight pooling)
LanguageData.Strata_PowerShaft_FeedingBelow: Supplying level below: {0} W from host surplus
LanguageData.Strata_PowerShaft_DecreaseLimitDesc: Lower the watt cap across this shaft (both ways). From unlimited, sets to what the grids can spare (live excess or batteries). Hold Shift for −500 W steps.
LanguageData.Strata_PowerShaft_IncreaseLimitDesc: Raise the watt cap across this shaft, up to live excess or battery headroom. Hold Shift for +500 W steps.
LanguageData.Strata_PowerShaft_UnlimitedDesc: Remove the watt cap so this shaft transfers as much as the grids need and can spare.
LanguageData.Strata_CrossLevelThreat_Text: Hostiles are active on {0}. The camera will jump there — defend that floor or seal the shaft.
LanguageData.Strata_OreHoistDriven: It is driven by the ore hoist on the level above.
LanguageData.Strata_OreHoistExtended: Ore hoist extended a skip to the linked level.
LanguageData.Strata_ShaftConduitDriven: It is driven by the conduit on the level above.
LanguageData.Strata_ShaftConduitExtended: Shaft conduit extended a junction to the level below.
LanguageData.Strata_FluidJunctionExtended: Shaft fluid junction extended a junction to the level below.
LanguageData.Strata_SealDesc: Seal this passage shut. Nobody can pass, no air or gas moves between the levels — use it to contain tox gas, smoke, or an infestation on one level.
LanguageData.Strata_DigDownFromLandingDesc: Designate a dig shaft beside this landing. Colonists must finish carving it — same work as an excavated stairwell — before the next level opens. Below the first underground level requires deep excavation research.
LanguageData.Strata_DigDownFromEntranceDesc: Break through to the level below once this stairwell is fully built, or use it if construction finished before research was available.
LanguageData.Strata_GeneratingLevel_Rock: Filling rock — large maps take a while; please wait…
LanguageData.Strata_OpenLevelFailed: Could not open the level below. Check Player.log, then use Dig down again to retry.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_OnlyUnderground: Dig down is only available below the surface.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_AlreadyBelow: This stairwell already reaches a level below.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_ShaftUnderConstruction: A dig shaft is still under construction.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_NoRoomNearby: No room nearby to carve a downward stairwell.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_LevelAlreadyOpen: The level below is already open.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_FailedOpen: Failed to open the level below.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_BrokeThroughNew: Broke through to a new level below.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_CouldNotPlaceShaft: Could not place a dig shaft.
LanguageData.Strata_Place_MustBeShaftRoom: Must be built in a stairwell or elevator room.
LanguageData.Strata_Place_GravshipNotLinkedLevel: Build gravship stairs on the ship deck, not on a linked Strata level.
LanguageData.Strata_Place_NeedsGravEngine: Needs a grav engine on this map.
LanguageData.Strata_Place_MustBeSubstructure: Must be built on the gravship substructure.
LanguageData.Strata_Place_NoColonyStairsOnGravship: Cannot build colony stairs on the gravship. Use a gravship stairwell instead.
LanguageData.Strata_Dig_NoColonyShaftOnGravshipLandin: Cannot dig a colony shaft from a gravship landing. Dig from a colony stairwell landing, or open another gravship shaft on the ship.
LanguageData.Strata_Place_MustBeOnGasVent: Must be placed on a deep gas vent.
LanguageData.Strata_GasIgnitionLetterText: A pocket of flammable gas has ignited on contact with {0} and exploded. The blast leaves black damp in the room — ventilate and restore oxygen before sending people back. Keep open flames away from gas seeps, or mine by electric light.
LanguageData.Strata_ExhaustNeedsPower: Needs power to enrich the room with {0}.
LanguageData.Strata_ExhaustVentIntake: Intake side must face an enclosed room.
LanguageData.Strata_ExhaustVentNoOutdoors: Duct run does not reach outdoors — fan cannot vent.
LanguageData.Strata_GasExchangerShaft: Must be in a stairwell or elevator room to exchange gases between levels.
LanguageData.Strata_GasExchangerActive: Driving O₂ up and CO₂ down the shaft.
LanguageData.Strata_GasExchangerNeedsPower: Needs power to boost gas exchange.
LanguageData.Strata_SmokeUpdraftShaft: Must be in a stairwell or elevator room to vent smoke upward.
LanguageData.Strata_GasWellNoVent: No deep gas vent below - producing nothing.
LanguageData.Strata_OreHoistNeedsPartner: Needs a linked partner hoist on another level.
LanguageData.Strata_OreHoistPowered: Powered — shuttling ore chunks to partner level.
LanguageData.Strata_OreHoistNeedsPowerSkip: Needs power to run the skip.
LanguageData.Strata_TremorOpenedStairwell: A tremor jarred a sealed stairwell open.
LanguageData.Strata_FluidTie_DrivenAbove: Tie: driven by the junction on the level above
LanguageData.Strata_FluidTie_LinkedBelow: Tie: linked to the junction on the level below
LanguageData.Strata_FluidTie_NoShaft: Tie: no shaft within reach - build within a few tiles of a stairwell or elevator
LanguageData.Strata_FluidTie_WaitingBelow: Tie: waiting for the level below to be opened
LanguageData.Strata_Cage_ReleaseDesc: Let the {0} out of the cage. It will stay on this tile.
LanguageData.Strata_Cage_AssignDescSustain: Place a tame {0} from nearby into this cage. Hunger is sustained while caged (mod setting).
LanguageData.Strata_Cage_AssignDescFeed: Place a tame {0} from nearby into this cage. Stock food in the cage to feed it.
LanguageData.Strata_Cage_DeadBody: Dead {0} — remove the body and assign or acquire another.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_WrongBirdCage: Only mine canaries belong in a canary cage — use a bird cage for other birds.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_Died: The canary in {0} has died from {1} — the air is lethal.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_NeedHay: Need {0} hay within reach to acquire a canary for {1}.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_KindMissing: Mine canary kind is not loaded.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_Acquired: A mine canary is now in {0}.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_AcquireDesc: Spawn a mine canary ({0} hay). Only mine canaries belong in this cage.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_DeadInspect: Canary dead{0}. Replace with {1} hay or assign another mine canary.
LanguageData.Strata_Canary_EmptyInspect: Empty — assign a nearby mine canary or acquire one ({0} hay).
LanguageData.Strata_CageFood_NoFood: No bird food within reach to stock {0}.
LanguageData.Strata_CageFood_StockDesc: Load up to {0} stacks of hay or other bird food from nearby into this cage.
LanguageData.Strata_CageFood_Empty: Cage food empty — stock hay or kibble.
LanguageData.Strata_RaidersFoundPortal: Raiders have found the {0} and are coming {1} after your colonists!
LanguageData.Strata_GravshipLevelsTravel: Strata: {0} linked level(s) will travel with the gravship.
LanguageData.Strata_GravshipLevelsDocked: Strata: {0} linked level(s) docked with the gravship.
LanguageData.Strata_GravshipTravelViewBlocked: Strata: cannot view underdeck/tower decks while the gravship is in flight (causes land graphics corruption). Open those floors after landing.
LanguageData.Strata_TravelWithShipDesc: When ON, this shaft's linked floor follows gravship launch. Turn OFF to leave the floor behind on the current world tile.
LanguageData.Strata_GravshipRescuedPawns: Strata: moved {0} prisoner(s)/baby(ies) onto the gravship so they would not be left behind.
LanguageData.Strata_GravshipLinkedLeftBehindWarn: Strata: these pawns are off the ship deck or on a linked floor that will not travel (prisoners/babies will be pulled aboard at launch): {0}
LanguageData.Strata_CannotRescueNoCrossLevelBed: Cannot rescue: no usable bed on this floor or a linked level.
LanguageData.Strata_LostMiners_HostileText: {0} desperate miners have broken into your underground workings and are hostile. Get eyes on that floor — they will fight.
LanguageData.Strata_AncientStairwellLetterText: Carved steps sink into the rock not far from your landing zone. They look stable enough to descend — and the stone below can be mined out into rooms — but there is no power tie through the shaft. Wire each level on its own, or build a modern stairwell or shaft conduit if you want grids to pool.
LanguageData.Strata_StairwellDigHint: Select Dig down to designate a dig shaft; colonists must finish carving it before the level below opens.
LanguageData.Strata_Letter_FirstB1Air_Text:
Below the surface, sealed rooms do not freely refresh oxygen.

Colonists inhale O₂ and exhale CO₂. Growing plants reverse that. Keep air breathable with open shafts, vents to the outdoors, oxygen / CO₂ pumps, lime scrubbers, shaft bellows or exchangers — or leave rooms open to the cavern.

Surface and A+ decks stay safe. Enable Natural gases in Mod Options to use this system (it is opt-in).
LanguageData.Strata_IncompatibleStackLetterText: Strata is loaded with {0}. These mods each run their own stacked maps and will fight. Disable the other mod(s) before playing — About.xml also marks them incompatible in the mod list.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_LowOxygen_Explanation: Colony rooms below the surface are running low on oxygen. Ventilate, open a shaft, add plants, or build an oxygen pump before colonists suffocate.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_HighCO2_Explanation: Carbon dioxide is building up around colonists underground. Scrub it, ventilate, or open a path to fresher air.
LanguageData.Strata_ElevatorCallDesc: Call this car to this floor. Colonists routing through the shaft prefer a recently called landing, and higher-priority floors are served first.
LanguageData.Strata_ElevatorPriorityDesc: How urgently this shaft should serve this floor (1 lowest, 5 highest). Workshop floors usually want a higher number than storage.
LanguageData.Strata_ElevatorHoldDesc: Keep the car here. Nobody can ride the powered direction until you release it. Return landings stay open so a blackout or hold can never trap anyone.
LanguageData.Strata_ElevatorHeld: The elevator is held at this level.
LanguageData.Strata_StampNoDest: No other linked level to stamp onto.
LanguageData.Strata_StampPrompt: Copy walls, doors, and columns from {0} onto {1} as blueprints. Rotate and offset before confirming.
LanguageData.Strata_PlaySettings_ShoringOverlayTip: Strata: show span and support\nGreen cells are carried by rock, columns, or shoring. Red cells are over-span — the ceiling will come down if you leave them unsupported.
LanguageData.Strata_Alert_UnsupportedSpan_Explanation: Part of an underground ceiling is past its support. Place shoring pillars, leave rock, or shrink the room before it collapses. The span overlay (bottom-right) marks carried cells in green and over-span in red.
LanguageData.Strata_Letter_UnsupportedSpan_Text: A stretch of excavated ceiling on this level is no longer carried by rock, columns, or shoring. It will come down if you ignore it — place pillars or leave rock while you still can. Toggle the span overlay from the bottom-right play settings to see which cells are at risk.
